singleSourced.value: Grand Theft Auto VI is coming to PlayStation 5 computer entertainment systems and Xbox Series X|S games and entertainment systems,
singleSourced.context: The official GTA 6 site now lists the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S as the consoles available at launch, and a previous press release sent out by Rockstar Games confirms that "Grand Theft Auto VI is coming to PlayStation 5 computer entertainment systems and Xbox Series X|S games and entertainment systems," seemingly confirming that GTA 6 will only release on next-gen consoles.

Grand Theft Auto 6 features a re-engineered, "more localized and persistent" weather system that ranges in intensity from physically credible rainbows to full-bore hurricanes, according to Rockstar vice president of art for lighting and rendering Owen Shepherd.
